summary.text: Sheila Ruth is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 44B and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She and fellow incumbent Aletheia McCaskill face Republican Domonic Martin for the district's two seats.
A website developer by profession, she serves on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee.

paragraphs.text: Sheila Ruth was born in Baltimore and earned a B.S. in liberal arts and technology from Villa Julie College in 1995, according to her legislative biography.
She worked as a computer specialist at the U.S. Government Accountability Office and a computer analyst at Stevenson University, and has been a self-employed website developer since 1995.
Ruth has been president of Imaginator Press since 2003.
Ballotpedia says Ruth assumed office on January 31, 2020.
The General Assembly website lists her as a member of the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee.
